artworks.title: Very Slippy Weather
artworks.artist: James Gillray after Rev. John Sneyd
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching and engraving on wove paper

artworks.title: Seated Youth Leaning against an Urn
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (proof before signature on urn)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.9 x 17.9 cm (5 1/2 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed group scene featuring figures interacting with architectural elements. The composition shows various characters engaged in subtle activities around a large, ornately carved vessel or urn. The urn is adorned with a relief depicting small figures and faces. The scene is intricately rendered with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating depth and texture. The background features stone columns and a crumbling wall. The figures are depicted in various poses, adding movement and interaction. Fine detail work emphasizes textures of clothing, stone, and architecture, showcasing a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail.

artworks.title: Two Men in Elaborate Costumes
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on light brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two sketched figures. One figure, seated and facing slightly sideways with their left arm extended, lacks distinct facial features and has long hair. The figure wears elaborate frills on their clothing. The other figure stands with a hand on their hip, also with long hair and similar attire. The drawing is in grayscale on textured paper, with no distinct background or additional objects. The focus is on the figures' attire and posture.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Man in a Feathered Hat (so-called Self-Portrait)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's head and shoulders. His head is slightly turned to the right, with a direct gaze. He has a thick mustache and a defined beard. His hair is textured and curls around his head. He wears a soft hat. The man is dressed in loose-fitting clothing, with a draped garment around his neck. In the upper left corner, there is text that reads "G. CASTILIΩVS GENOVESE. FE."

artworks.title: Bearded Man in a Fur Cap, Facing Left
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the head and part of the upper body of a person in profile, facing to the left. The individual has strong facial features, including a prominent nose and a thick mustache. The face is framed by textured facial hair that covers the jawline and chin. The person's hair is long and flowing from under a large hat. The hat has a fur-like brim and a flat top with notable texture. The individual wears a garment with a patterned collar. In the background, there is intricate line work indicating depth and shading, with no specific objects or elements defined.

artworks.title: Bearded Man with Shadowed Face, Wearing a Scarf and a Plumed Hat
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person facing slightly towards the left with their head tilted. The facial features are obscured by detailed etching, with the eyes and mouth faintly discernible. The individual wears a large, feathered hat dominating the upper part of the image, and extended hair or material adds to the texture. They have a shawl or cloth around their neck, with no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with the inscriptions "Castiglione" and "Genovese" in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Pan and Olympus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.6 x 11.5 cm (8 1/8 x 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures in a natural setting. The drawing depicts fantastical creatures, including two humanoid figures with goat-like characteristics, possibly satyrs, one playing a flute-like instrument while the other is present. Below them, two cherubic figures are interacting near a jar from which water is flowing. The background features lush foliage, creating a serene atmosphere. Detailed lines convey the whimsy and tranquility of this mystical scene.

artworks.title: Pan Overcome by Putti
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 17.2 x 21.9 cm (6 3/4 x 8 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two angel-like creatures wrestling with a centaur. The scene captures two figures with wings appearing to struggle with the centaur. The drawing features fine lines, intricate shading, and minimal background details suggesting a natural setting with foliage and clouds.

artworks.title: Siren and Triton
artworks.artist: Theodor van Kessel after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical sea creatures. The drawing features a central figure with a muscular upper body and a serpent-like lower half, holding a female figure with similar traits. Another smaller figure, resembling a cherub, is flying nearby. The scene is set against a backdrop that includes clouds and a partially visible rocky landscape. The figures exhibit dynamic interactions, with the fabric draped around some of them appearing to be caught in the wind. The meticulous crosshatching and detailed line work create a sense of depth and texture.

artworks.title: Standing Peasant
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15.1 x 11.2 cm (5 15/16 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a relaxed position with their arms crossed in front of them. The individual is facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have pronounced facial features, slightly furrowed brow, loosely curled hair, and are wearing a loose, textured garment. They also wear a loose, brimmed hat and simple footwear. The person appears to be holding a musical instrument in their arms, possibly a string or wind instrument, as its shape is only partially depicted. The background is plain and textured, with simple lines and shading suggestive of foliage or ground lines, but largely undefined.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.9 x 9.6 cm (3 1/8 x 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of an elderly man in a semi-reclined position, facing to the right. He has a thick beard, curly hair, wide-open eyes, a strong nose, and chin. He is shirtless, with a cloth draping across his shoulder and chest. He holds a large book with several pages, and his hands are visible. The background features a pattern of diagonal lines, giving the impression of a traditional sketch style.

artworks.title: Cupid Looking in a Mirror
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cherubic child or putto sitting on draped fabric. The child is positioned with its right leg extended and its left leg bent, leaning slightly forward. It holds a feather or quill in its right hand and looks downward. The child has curly hair and a soft, rounded face. It is unclothed, surrounded by large leaves and drapery, suggesting a natural environment. In the background, there are detailed trees and branches with fine lines indicating foliage and a distant landscape. The artwork is shaded to create depth.

artworks.title: Three Flying Putti
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate): 7.9 x 10.1 cm (3 1/8 x 4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three cherubs in a cloudy sky with birds. The image depicts three cherubic figures interacting with each other amidst a background of clouds and sky.

artworks.title: Three Flying Putti
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate): 7.7 x 10 cm (3 1/16 x 3 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three cherubic figures amidst clouds. The composition depicts the cherubic figures in the sky, with one holding a ribbon or sash. The figures have curly hair and robust forms. Two birds are in flight in the upper right corner. Stylized clouds and diagonal lines are in the background, with intricate cross-hatching adding texture and depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape
artworks.description: This is a monochrome engraving of a mountainous landscape. The perspective is from a lower angle, showing a small stream cutting through rocky terrain towards distant mountains. The horizon is high, partially obscured by towering peaks. The artist used intricate linework and cross-hatching to depict textures and shadows, adding depth to the image. Trees with detailed foliage line the stream, and rocky slopes guide the eye towards snow-capped peaks under a cloud-filled sky. The color palette is grayscale, emphasizing details in the scene.

artworks.title: The Churchgoers
artworks.artist: William Young Ottley after Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.7 x 11 cm (6 9/16 x 4 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing side by side. The person on the left is in profile, wearing a robe and a hood. They have distinct facial features and are holding a string of beads. The person on the right is facing forward, wearing a robe with long sleeves and a hat. They have a rounded face with short, wavy hair visible. This person holds a walking stick. Both figures stand on a textured floor with decorative patterns in the background. An animal is near the person on the right.

artworks.title: Beggar Seated on a Bank
artworks.artist: Costantino Cumano after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 11.3 x 8.6 cm (4 7/16 x 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated with his legs bent and crossed in front of him. His facial expression is curious, with a slightly open mouth and eyes looking towards the viewer. He has thick, curly hair framing his face. The man is dressed in a loose-fitting garment, appears to be barefoot, and is not wearing any visible jewelry. He holds a part of his garment in one hand, while the other arm rests on his knee. The background is minimalistic, with sketch-like textures and shading.

artworks.title: Cottage with White Paling
artworks.artist: William Byron after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural setting near a water body. The point of view is slightly elevated, capturing the scene from above. A windmill is visible on the horizon to the left. The composition focuses on the land and structures, with intricate lines creating texture and depth. The color palette is primarily sepia, capturing light and shadow. Ducks glide on the water, reflecting the surroundings. A small boat is tied to the shore, and a cottage is partially visible beyond the shrubbery.

artworks.title: Young Man Playing the Hurdy-Gurdy
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the upper body up, slightly turned to their right with their head tilted downward. Their facial features are shadowed by dim lighting, framed by shoulder-length straight hair. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat with a feather and a dark cloak or coat. No visible jewelry or objects are present. The background is dark.

artworks.title: Cow
artworks.description: The image shows a low perspective with a close view of a large cow in the center. The horizon is visible in the upper part, with a sky filled with cross-hatched patterns suggesting clouds. The grass is detailed with fine etching lines. The cow is depicted in light tones with intricate shading for volume. Other cows are scattered near a water body and bushes. The color palette is monochrome with various shades of brown and beige, highlighting the detailed line work.

artworks.title: Allegory of Vanity
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6 x 7.3 cm (2 3/8 x 2 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a cherub-like figure sitting down. The figure has a reclined posture on the ground with legs extended and one arm on its knee while the other arm is bent. The figure has a cherub face with chubby cheeks and short hair. It is naked. An hourglass is near its left side. There are bushes and trees around the figure. In the background, there is a classical architectural element, possibly a column. The artwork is detailed with illustrative lines.

artworks.title: Fantasy of a Magnificent Wall Monument
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, with some gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural design featuring ornate sculptures and reliefs. The drawing showcases a decorative architectural facade, with a central motif composed of classical figures draped with garlands. Above these figures is a rectangular section with inscribed text. Beneath the figures, circular plaques depict classical profiles and motifs, and the base includes intricate carvings of eagles and other ornamental designs. The composition utilizes detailed line work and shading, enhancing the three-dimensional quality of the reliefs and sculptures.

artworks.title: Title Page for Biblia Sacra Cvm Glossa Ordinaria
artworks.artist: Hans Collaert the Younger after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page for a religious text. The drawing includes detailed decorative elements surrounding the title "Biblia Sacra cum Glossa Ordinaria." At the top of the image, a figure representing Theologia stands on a pedestal between two columns decorated with shields and cherubic figures. The left shield displays a pentagram with Latin text, while the right shield features the "IHS" Christogram. Flanking the central figure are two sculpturesque figures in classical attire. Below the central pediment, the primary text is inscribed in a rectangular frame and adorned with iconography including angelic and demonic motifs, all within a richly ornamented stone-like border. The artwork showcases intricate Baroque design elements emphasizing theological and classical sculpture stylings.

artworks.title: Title Page for Herman Hugo's "Obsidio Bredana"
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate and historical title page. The image features an elaborate title page adorned with classical motifs and intricate detailing, bordered by draped figures and cherubs. The central oval cartouche displays the text "OBSIDIO BREDANA ARMIS PHILIPPI IIII. AVSPICIIS ISABELLÆ DVC TV AMBR. SPINOLÆ PERFECTA. SCRIBEBAT HERMANNVS HUGO SOCIETATIS IESV," surrounded by an intricate design with symbolic elements. Hierarchical figures flank each side, one muscular and partially nude holding a shovel, while the other is dressed in flowing garments. At the top, two winged cherubs reach towards the cartouche with a decorative flourish. Below them, a seated figure is entwined with another. The entire composition exudes a sense of regal importance.
